touch_derivation: Bar open=100, high=104, low=85, close=95 with stop 90, TARGET-NEAR 105, TARGET-FAR 110 under raw_close_only_v1. Long: high 104 < 105 so neither target touches; low 85 <= 90 so the stop touches. Design 12:339 - only one class touches, so all three policies select it. Reference price: open 100 is not <= stop 90, low 85 <= 90, so the reference is the stop level 90 (design 10 table row 2, reproduced by the legacy raw evaluator at exits.py:400-406). Sell with slippage_bps 0: floor_to_price_tick(90, 1) = 90.
cash_ledger_join: Design 2.1:75, 3:100 step 11 and 13:376. The in-window ledger is FEE(F0) -0.081 (fee_notional abs(90 * 2 * 1) = 180) then GROSS(F0) -20. The pre-window entry fill at 2000-01-01T00:11:00Z charged its own ENTRY fee of 0.09 (fee_notional 100 * 2 * 1), so equity_curve.first = 1000 - 0.09 = 999.91 and equity_curve.last = 999.91 - 0.081 - 20 = 979.829. Re-derived under design 23.2:1057-1064, which now fixes the window-scoped reading V15-D02 flagged as unfixed; the design labels that scope an AMENDMENT-CHOICE (:1066-1072).
